description: List recently received messages. Text only: never the sender's HTML.

from.description: Only mail from this sender: an address, or a domain and its subdomains (github.com takes mail.github.com, never github.com.evil.example).

q.description: Case-insensitive text in the subject, body or sender address.

since.description: Only mail received at or after this ISO 8601 time.

to.description: Only mail sent to this address, such as a plus address of the agent's receiving address (qa.acme+run-1842@in.mails.ai).

name: mails_list_received
title: List received emails
